result.summary: Found 2 issues: cards and content are being cut off horizontally, preventing users from seeing full restaurant names and complete card information.

issues.description: The third restaurant card in 'Fastest near you' section shows truncated text - 'Trattoria Piccol' appears to be cut off (likely 'Trattoria Piccolo')
issues.suggestion: Ensure the horizontal scrolling container has proper overflow handling or adjust card width to prevent text truncation. Consider using text ellipsis or ensure full names are visible.

issues.description: The bottom restaurant card in 'Popular right now' section is partially cut off - only the pizza image and discount badge are visible, while the restaurant name, rating, and delivery details are missing or out of view
issues.suggestion: Fix the card layout to ensure all content (restaurant name, ratings, delivery time, and price) are fully visible. Check if the card is properly constrained within the viewport.

issues.description: A partially visible category button appears on the far right of the category filter row, suggesting horizontal scroll content that's not fully accessible
issues.suggestion: Either hide the partially visible button or adjust the scrollable container so all options are fully visible or properly indicate there are more options to scroll to.
